title: The White Coat Ceremony
intro: Hall A is full. Families fill the upper rows with phones raised; your class sits in the front rows in their best clothes, the coats folded on a long table on the stage.

steps.say: "The coat you receive today is short. That's on purpose. It says you're a student, that there is a great deal still to learn, and that the patients who let you learn from them are doing you a kindness."
steps.speaker: Dr. Evelyn Carter, Dean

steps.say: "It also says something to them. When you walk into a room in this coat, people will tell you things they have told no one else. Deserve that."
steps.speaker: Dr. Evelyn Carter, Dean

steps.say: Dr. Lena Park reads the names. Yours comes. You cross the stage; your faculty advisor holds the coat open and you slip your arms in. It's heavier than it looks, the pockets already weighed down with a pen light and a pocket guide.
The whole class stands and, together, reads the oath your class wrote in orientation week.

"I will put the good of my patients first. I will respect their dignity, their choices and their privacy. I will admit what I do not know and ask for help when I need it. I will treat my colleagues with the same respect I owe my patients. I will look after myself, so that I can look after others. And I will keep learning for as long as I practice."
steps.speaker: The Class of 2030

choice.prompt: On the quad afterward, your family asks what the coat means to you.

options.text: "That people are going to trust me before I've earned it. I have to earn it."
options.reply: Your mother squeezes your hand. "You will."

options.text: "That this is real now. I'm really doing this."
options.reply: Your father laughs. "You've been doing it for weeks. Now it's official."

options.text: "That I have a lot to learn. Short coat, long road."
options.reply: "Short coat, long road," your grandmother repeats, and makes you pose for another photo.

steps.say: Photos on the quad, the whole class in white. Somebody's little brother tries on a coat that reaches his ankles.
